seo_title: AI for Handwritten Delivery Notes: Extract Data Instantly
seo_desc: Wasting hours manually entering delivery notes into your ERP? We integrate Artificial Intelligence to read handwritten notes and automate your B2B data entry.
author_pitch: I have seen warehouse managers ruin their eyesight trying to decipher drivers' handwriting. My mission is to deploy visual artificial intelligence that reads those scribbles for you, eliminating inventory errors and freeing up your time.
title: Artificial Intelligence for Delivery Notes: Automate Handwritten Text Reading
body:
Does your administration manager waste the entire morning typing crumpled delivery notes brought by drivers into the ERP?

In sectors like construction, logistics, or wholesale distribution, paper still rules. Drivers and operators hurriedly jot down quantities, batches, and signatures on delivery notes with terrible handwriting. Manually transferring that data into your management system is not only a tedious and exhausting job, but it also causes constant errors: a "7" that looks like a "1" can throw off your entire inventory and ruin the month's billing.

The trap of traditional OCR scanners

Many managers buy basic optical recognition systems, only to realize they only work for perfect printed letters on digital invoices, failing miserably when faced with human handwriting. Trying to read pen scribbles with ten-year-old technology is throwing your SME's money away.

Our solution: Computational Vision AI Engine

At LANZAESTUDIO we implement Artificial Intelligence models trained specifically to understand human handwriting, processing even crumpled or stained notes directly from a mobile phone camera.

  1. Immediate Mobile Capture: The warehouse worker takes a photo of the delivery note with their phone, and the artificial intelligence instantly cleans the image and removes shadows.
  2. Handwriting Extraction: Our neural networks read the handwritten text, identifying item references, crossed-out quantities, and margin notes with near-human accuracy.
  3. Catalog Validation: The AI cross-references what it has read with your B2B database; if it detects a doubtful reference, it alerts a human to confirm it in a second.
  4. Direct ERP Injection: The structured data is automatically sent to your management software, updating stock levels without the need to type absolutely anything.

The Real Impact on Your Company's Logistics

  • Massive Hours Saved: Administrative work that previously consumed half the day is reduced to a simple review of a couple of minutes a day.
  • Always Accurate Inventory: You eradicate human errors when entering numbers, ensuring your system's virtual inventory finally matches your physical warehouse.
  • Billing Acceleration: By having deliveries registered instantly, your accounting department can issue invoices immediately, getting paid much sooner.
